title: rest: a declared client refusal (400 ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT on a record write, 422 INVALID_METADATA on a metadata save) is logged as "[REST] Unhandled error" with a full stack trace on every request
body:
**Filing gate ①** — product defect with a named landing point and a live reproduction. Reach: public entry — the `/api/v1/data` and `/api/v1/meta` HTTP doors, measured on a stock showcase boot: every refused write prints an error-level `[REST] Unhandled error:` line plus a stack trace in the server log.

**Reader who acts:** the seat that owns `packages/rest` (error classification door), in the PR that extends `isExpectedRouteError` in `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`.

## What happens

`logUnexpectedRouteError` logs `[REST] Unhandled error` unless `isExpectedRouteError(status, body)` is true or the error is a declared 5xx refusal (`declaredRefusalMessage`). `isExpectedRouteError` admits only 403/404/409/502/503, the query-rejection codes (`UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM`, `INVALID_FIELD`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `INVALID_FILTER`, `INVALID_SORT`, `INVALID_QUERY`) and `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Two coded, producer-declared client refusals fall outside that list, so each one is logged as a server fault:

| door | refusal on the wire | log |
|---|---|---|
| `POST`/`PATCH /api/v1/data/:object` with a file reference violating a field's declared `accept`/`maxSize` | 400 `{"error":"File type 'application/pdf' is not permitted by the accept list declared for 'poster' (image/png, image/jpeg)","code":"ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT","object":"qa_media"}` | `[REST] Unhandled error: FileConstraintError: …` + 10-frame stack + `{ code: 'ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT', status: 400, field: 'poster', constraint: 'accept' }` |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` with a body that fails spec validation (e.g. a retired translation key) | 422 `{"code":"INVALID_METADATA","issues":[…]}` | `[REST] Unhandled error: Error: translation/NAME failed spec validation: …` + stack + `{ code: 'INVALID_METADATA', status: 422, issues: […] }` |

This is the drift class `isExpectedQueryRejection`'s own docblock records ("the filter and sort codes shipped without joining the list, so every rejection they produced was ALSO logged as an unhandled error") and #4886 fixed for the metadata 404s: `FileConstraintError` gained a declared `status: 400` (the wire now answers 400 with the prose, not the sanitized 500) without joining the predicate, and `INVALID_METADATA` 422 is the metadata door's per-item validation refusal — the same kind of answer as `VALIDATION_FAILED`, which is already listed. The consequence is operator-facing: a Studio author iterating on a translation or a form widget enforcing accept/maxSize produces one error-level stack per attempt, indistinguishable in the log from a genuine handler fault.

## Reproduction

Stock showcase, isolated boot: `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:DIR/data.db` (main `2034975a`), signed in as the seeded admin.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.objectstack.qa.media","name":"QA media","version":"1.0.0","type":"app"},"enableOnInstall":true}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_media?package=com.objectstack.qa.media` `{"name":"qa_media","label":"QA Media","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name","required":true},"poster":{"type":"image","label":"Poster","accept":["image/png","image/jpeg"],"maxSize":1048576}}}` → 200.
3. Mint a file: `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned` `{"filename":"probe.pdf","mimeType":"application/pdf","size":10240}` → PUT the bytes to `uploadUrl` → `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/complete {"fileId":ID}`.
4. `POST /api/v1/data/qa_media` `{"name":"accept-probe","poster":ID}` → **400 ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT** (correct) and the server log prints `[REST] Unhandled error: FileConstraintError: …` with a stack (wrong).
5. `PUT /api/v1/meta/translation/qa_strict_zh` `{"name":"qa_strict_zh","locale":"zh-CN","objects":{"showcase_task":{"label":"x"}},"o":{"x":1}}` → **422 INVALID_METADATA** naming the retired `o` key (correct) and the log prints `[REST] Unhandled error: Error: translation/qa_strict_zh failed spec validation: …` with a stack (wrong).

Expected: both refusals are expected client outcomes and print no `[REST] Unhandled error` line (at most the one-line withheld-fault note the door already uses). Actual: one error-level line + stack per request. Measured across two boots of the same DB: 5 `FileConstraintError` and 12 `INVALID_METADATA` stacks, one per refused request.

## Mechanism

- `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` — `isExpectedRouteError` / `isExpectedQueryRejection` / `isExpectedDataStatus` (the allow-list) and `logUnexpectedRouteError` (the only log decision).
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/file-reference-lifecycle.ts` — `FileConstraintError` now declares `code: 'ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT'` + `status: 400`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol` `saveMetaItem` throws the 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with `issues`.

A fix that keeps the predicate's stated narrowness ("deliberately NOT any 4xx") adds the two codes by name, with a pin that a refused accept/maxSize write and a refused metadata save each produce no `[REST] Unhandled error` line.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `REST Unhandled error logged with stack trace for declared 4xx refusal ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT INVALID_METADATA isExpectedRouteError` → 7 hits (#22764, #22885, #20603, #14656, #8016, #4886, #11588 — all closed, none covers these two codes); `"Unhandled error" log noise expected client error 400 422 stack trace` → 3 hits (#5437, #4886, #5489 — closed, different codes). No open card.
